notes.heading: Cost of Quality (CoQ)
points: Kabuuang gastos para maiwasan, mahanap at maayos ang defects.
Apat na categories: prevention, appraisal, internal failure, external failure.

notes.heading: Failure costs
points: Internal failure: defects na nahanap bago i-release.
External failure: defects na nahanap na ng customer, kaya mas mahal.

questions.answer: The total cost of preventing, finding and fixing defects in a product.
questions.explanation: Ito yung kabuuang gastos para siguraduhing maayos ang quality, kasama ang prevention, appraisal at failure costs.

questions.prompt: Which cost category includes testing and inspection?
questions.explanation: Ang appraisal cost ay gastos sa pag-check ng quality, gaya ng testing at inspection.

questions.prompt: Costs from defects found by customers after release.
questions.explanation: External failure cost kasi na-detect na ng customer ang defect, hindi na sa loob ng company.

questions.prompt: Enumerate the 4 categories of the cost of quality.
questions.answer: Prevention; Appraisal; Internal failure; External failure
questions.explanation: Apat ang categories ng CoQ: dalawa para iwasan o hanapin ang defects, dalawa para sa failures.

questions.prompt: Fixing a defect usually costs less the later it is found.
questions.explanation: Mali, kasi mas mahal ayusin ang defect habang tumatagal bago ito makita.

questions.prompt: Training developers is an example of appraisal cost.
questions.explanation: Ang training ay prevention cost kasi iniiwasan nito ang defects bago pa mangyari.
